finding: TARGETS byte difference between environments comes only from floating-point rounding (<= 2 ulp) in geometric_range_m and in the common-yaw pose matrices (historical_mount_frames); pose_id is a content hash of the pose matrices, so a 1-2 ulp matrix difference changes pose_id. No coordinate, identity, scene, frame, panel or clearance difference.

evidence.source: independent audit 2026-09-27 of HEAD 1e2ac03 (DIFF.json, FP_WIN.json, FIELD_DIGEST_DIFF.json, F5_DIAGNOSIS.json in the reviewer audit folder; not re-run in this checkout)
evidence.other_fields: identical (target_id, order, tx/rx, source_sha256, frame hash, panels, clearance)
evidence.closure: substituting only geometric_range_m and pose_id with canonical values reproduces the canonical file SHA exactly
evidence.attribution: OS/libm/BLAS source of each bit not isolated; not required

policy: Canonical TARGETS.jsonl and its POSES.json/PANELS.json are deployed together unchanged; SHAs stay as recorded in 00_inputs_R3/CONFIG.json.
Never pair a TARGETS/POSES recomputed in another environment with the canonical set; never replace the hash with the Windows value or with a tolerance check.
S0 is not regenerated on Windows for production; prepare_sionna_full refuses a different TARGETS digest (INPUT_REVISION_CHANGED).
enforcement: expected_run_key: POSES.json/PANELS.json SHA must equal CONFIG poses_sha256/panels_sha256 (test_recomputed_poses_cannot_be_paired_with_canonical_targets)
stage_manifest: TARGETS/POSES/PANELS/STATIC9 overlay staged only if SHA equals CONFIG
